import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Arrays;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);

        int round = Integer.parseInt(scanner.nextLine().trim());
        String[] firstperson = scanner.nextLine().trim().split(" ");
        String[] secondperson = scanner.nextLine().trim().split(" ");

        solve(round, firstperson, secondperson);
    }

    public static void solve(int round, String[] firstperson, String[] secondperson) {
        int win = 0;
        // Append first element of secondperson to its end
        String[] extendedSecondPerson = Arrays.copyOf(secondperson, secondperson.length + 1);
        extendedSecondPerson[secondperson.length] = secondperson[0];

        for (int i = 0; i < firstperson.length; i++) {
            int fpVal = Integer.parseInt(firstperson[i]);
            int spNextVal = Integer.parseInt(extendedSecondPerson[i + 1]);
            int minVal;
            if (fpVal <= spNextVal) {
                minVal = fpVal;
            } else {
                minVal = spNextVal;
            }
            win += minVal;
        }

        // Remove the appended element
        extendedSecondPerson = Arrays.copyOf(extendedSecondPerson, secondperson.length);

        // Insert third element of secondperson at start
        String[] reorderedSecondPerson = new String[secondperson.length];
        reorderedSecondPerson[0] = secondperson[2];
        System.arraycopy(secondperson, 0, reorderedSecondPerson, 1, secondperson.length - 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < firstperson.length; i++) {
            int fpVal = Integer.parseInt(firstperson[i]);
            int spVal = Integer.parseInt(reorderedSecondPerson[i]);
            int spNextVal = Integer.parseInt(reorderedSecondPerson[(i + 1) % reorderedSecondPerson.length]);

            if (fpVal > 0) {
                int diff = Math.min(fpVal, spVal);
                firstperson[i] = Integer.toString(fpVal - diff);
                reorderedSecondPerson[i] = Integer.toString(spVal - diff);
                if (Integer.parseInt(firstperson[i]) > 0) {
                    int diff2 = Math.min(Integer.parseInt(firstperson[i]), Integer.parseInt(reorderedSecondPerson[(i + 1) % reorderedSecondPerson.length]));
                    firstperson[i] = Integer.toString(Integer.parseInt(firstperson[i]) - diff2);
                    reorderedSecondPerson[(i + 1) % reorderedSecondPerson.length] = Integer.toString(Integer.parseInt(reorderedSecondPerson[(i + 1) % reorderedSecondPerson.length]) - diff2);
                }
            }
        }

        int firstPersonSum = 0;
        for (String val : firstperson) {
            firstPersonSum += Integer.parseInt(val);
        }

        System.out.println(firstPersonSum + " " + win);
    }
}
